Levl Trading Bot · Quick Setup

Set Up
In 7 Steps

The short version. Every step, nothing extra. Details and troubleshooting are in the full guide.

November 2026 · Levl Nemesis · Levl Icarus · MNQ · 5 minute chart

Steps
  1. You need
  2. Connect broker

00Before you start

You need

  • TradingView paid plan with 2-factor authentication on, and real-time CME data (or your Tradovate account connected to TradingView).
  • TradersPost account.
  • One futures account per bot, connected through Tradovate. Not ProjectX.
Three rules One bot per account. Never trade against a bot on another account (hedging). Settings first, alert last: change a setting later, create the alert again.
01TradersPost

Connect your broker

Sign up at TradersPost (code LEVL, 20% off). Brokers → Connect Broker, log in to your firm.

02TradingView

Put the bot on your chart

MNQ, 5 minutes. Add the bot, open Inputs:

Account drawdown limit
Your account's max drawdown (50K = 2,000).
Risk profile
Recommended. What each setting risks in dollars: risk tables.
Everything else
Leave as it is.
03TradersPost

Create the strategy

Strategies → New Strategy:

Name
Levl Nemesis or Levl Icarus
Style · Asset class
Systematic · Futures
Allow auto submit, live trading, signal overrides
All three ticked.

Save and copy the webhook URL. Keep it private.

04TradersPost

Three settings

Edit Subscription Defaults, toggle at the top on:

Allowed sides
Both Sides
Entry order type
Market. Take profit and stop loss stay on None, both override boxes ticked.
Exit order type
Market

Save the strategy.

05TradersPost

Subscribe and enable

Subscribe → pick the account for this bot → Auto Submit → Save → Enable. The badge must read Enabled in green.

06TradingView

Create the alert

Condition
The bot → alert() function calls only
Expiration
Open-ended, or the longest date offered (set a reminder)
Notifications
Webhook URL from step 3, nothing else

Create. One alert per bot. No order fill alert.

07Done

Check it worked

After the first trade, TradersPost Signals shows the order on a real contract (e.g. MNQZ2026) with 1 / 1, and Trades shows stop and target attached.

Second bot Repeat steps 2 to 6 on a second account, its own chart and its own strategy.
